curriculum.title: Executive Resume & Credentials Portal
curriculum.subtitle: Executive Coach • ISO Lead Auditor • Production Engineer & Economist
curriculum.summary: Production & Quality Engineer (Simón Bolívar University), Economist, ISO Lead Auditor in Integrated Management Systems (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001 RAC/IRCA, IATF-16949), and IBM 2025 Executive Coach with 30 years of international industrial experience. Specialist in process optimization, quality management, continuous improvement (Lean Manufacturing, Green Belt Six Sigma, 8D, NCR), and JIT inventory management. Proven track record at companies like Rototech, Tapeçaria Palacio, D'classe Papeis, and General Motors, leading projects with a proven 30% reduction in customer complaints, 25% reduction in inventory costs, and 15% increase in production capacity.

roles.title: Quality and Process Coordinator
responsibilities: Coordinate comprehensive quality management activities and production process optimization.
Lead continuous improvement implementation on operational lines applying Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma.
Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 quality standards and customer requirements.
Conduct internal and external audits, identifying non-conformities (NCRs) and driving 8D treatments.
achievements: Achieved 1 successful recertification of ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System (QMS).
Passed 1 QMS maintenance audit with zero critical non-conformities.
Strengthened plant quality and operational hygiene culture aligned with customer standards.

humanBehavior.title: Organizational Human Behavior
humanBehavior.subtitle: Corporate psychopedagogy, talent development and adaptive leadership integrated with industrial experience, management-system auditing and executive coaching.
humanBehavior.intro: Management systems take hold when people understand the change and have the tools to apply it. This service complements industrial and audit experience with a focus on learning, behavior and team dynamics.

items.title: Diagnosis and change adoption
items.text: Identify learning needs, resistance and available team resources to support management-system implementation, digital transformation and organizational change.

items.title: Training and talent development
items.text: Corporate learning programs and individual development plans adapted to employees' needs, competencies and learning approaches.

items.title: Teams and adaptive leadership
items.text: Executive coaching, emotional intelligence, communication, conflict management and multidisciplinary team composition aligned with project goals.

humanBehavior.methodText: Corporate psychopedagogy is used as a framework for understanding how teams learn. Behavioral-profile models and Sheldon's somatotypes are treated only as complementary exploratory perspectives—not clinical diagnoses or sole criteria for selecting or classifying people.
humanBehavior.outcomeText: Support change adoption, strengthen collaboration and connect people development with operational and quality goals.
